newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Mercury rating raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mercury rating raised.

text.p: - Robert W. Baird & Co analyst Bill McGinnis said he raised his recommendation on Mercury Finance Co to a strong buy from an accumulate rating based on the stock price of the consumer finance company.

- McGinnis said he believes shares of Mercury Finance are significantly undervalued following a recent dramatic price decline. Mercury Finance had reported yesterday that it restated its 1995 earnings and took a 1996 third quarter charge after adopting a change in accounting for loss reserves. Shares of Mercury Finance fell 1-7/8 on the news.
- McGinnis said the accounting change will not hurt the company's future earnings and does clarify and make consistent the company's reserving policy.
- Mercury Finance stock was trading up 1-1/8 to 11-1/4.
